description: What counts as landing on a pad. Every number follows from the pad (configs/targets/objects.json), the vehicle (configs/robot_quadrotor_fastphysics.jsonc) or a measurement in the simulator (docs/aerovla_oft_gen_v3.md, 'Landing in the simulator'); none is tuned to a result.

vehicle.half_span_from: rotor hubs at +-0.253 m on both axes plus the propeller radius
vehicle.rest_offset_from: height of the body origin above the surface it rests on, measured at spawn (0.193 m) and on a pad's marking (0.158 m)

touchdown.definition: the collision topic names the pad or its marking while the vehicle is above the pad's top surface; the simulator holds the vehicle still from that moment
touchdown.landing_region_from: pad half-width (7.0 m) minus the vehicle half-span (0.4 m): the whole vehicle stands on the pad
touchdown.max_vertical_speed_from: the action range allows 1.0 m/s of descent and the teacher's final descent is 0.5 m/s; half-way between the two separates a controlled descent from one at full rate
touchdown.max_horizontal_speed_from: a quarter of the 2.0 m/s the action range allows forward

stages.aligned_from: a quarter of the pad's width: the marking's centre lies inside the middle of the down view from every flight height used

teacher.align_radius_from: an eighth of the pad's width
